title: Malaysian Hash Browns
description: A twist on the classic hash browns, with a malaysian flavor from the malaysian potatoes. Crispy and golden.

ingredients.name: malaysian potatoes
ingredients.notes: choose potatoes with a yellowed or new skin

ingredients.name: hash
ingredients.notes: crushed or chopped hash for added texture

instructions: Peel the malaysian potatoes and grate them into a large bowl.
Add the garlicky new potatoes to the bowl and mix well.
Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat.
Add the hash to the pan and cook for 2-3 minutes.
Add the potato mixture to the pan and press down to form a flat layer.
Cook for 4-5 minutes on the first side, or until the bottom is golden brown.
Flip the hash browns over and cook for an additional 3-4 minutes.
